name: (07) Dominate — 3 Advanced — Speak Through the Blood

system.description:
Through the blood that binds a lineage, a Methuselah issues her will to every descendant, wherever they are, spinning entire broods toward ends they believe are their own.

Spend a permanent Willpower Trait and make a Mental Challenge against the subject, who must be of your own lineage; distance and location are no barrier. On a success you may plant commands in the subject's mind. Orders must be generic and long-term ("Defend the Camarilla against all its enemies"); specific or instantaneous commands cannot be given, and the change takes hold only gradually over years. It combines potently with powers such as Mass Manipulation.
system.duration: Five years per permanent Willpower Trait
